jobs_results.title: Senior Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Senior Python Developer at Exo Investing
• Djangojobs.Net Login Register Jobs Companies Post About Pricing Salary Contact Senior Python Developer at Exo Investing Madrid,Spain Jul 09, 2018 Read Interview about Exo Investing https://medium.com/@djnjobs/djangojobs-interviews-1-e9d5000197c For our Madrid office, we are looking for a Senior Python Developer to join our team in building awesome trading and rebalancing algorithms as well as integrations of third party APIs and FIX trading protocols. The ideal candidate should be proficient in Python 3, Django and be very familiar with SQL databases, Redis, REST APIs and Amazon Web Services. As a young company we are looking for people who are self-starters with a can-do attitude and an entrepreneurial mindset. As our team is still small, you will have to wear a lot of different hats - but it also means that you can specialise in a field you enjoy and become the expert in your area. We value diversity in educational backgrounds and all other... aspects of life. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we really want to hear from you. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our CEO Lennart (******) or CTO Antonio (******) directly. Our technology stack
• Python 3- Django- PostgreSQL- Celery- Redis- AWS EC2, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS- Ansible Our company language is English. Requiremets Key responsibilities Integration of user-facing elements developed by front-end developers with server side logic.Implementation of security and data protection.Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system. Development tasks
• Developing RESTful APIs.- Creating a global flexible configurable architecture- Integrating third-party APIs.- Working with task queues such as Celery.- Using AWS services- Automating testing with PyTest.- In Git, working with branches and rebases.- Implementing security best practices Benefits As a young and growing startup that is also a co-venture between two world-class players in their fields, we combine the best of two worlds: access to the resources of strong partners and the agile environment to really make a difference. Our technical development team is based in Madrid, all operating functions are based in the heart of the City in London. Both environments offer all the flexibility and perks that you expect from a small but quickly growing firm. At our Madrid location, we will also treat you to the following: On-site chef for lunch. A breakfast kitchen and fruit during the day. A budget for your equipment. Access to personal and professional learning resources. Position: Employee Work Schedule: Full-time Remote: No Relocation: No Salary: Not Specified How to Apply Position is expired. Thanks for your interest. jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Python
jobs_results.description:
Desde Serem nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un DESARROLLADOR PYTHON especializado en con al menos 3 años de experiencia para importante cliente.

Requerimientos:

Desarrollador Python competente con experiencia en SQL (específicamente Postgres) y familiaridad con el entorno AWS.

- Competencia avanzada en Python para el desarrollo de scripts, aplicaciones y servicios (+ pruebas unitarias, pruebas de integración, mejores prácticas de desarrollo, experiencia con marcos web)

- Excelente conocimiento de SQL para la manipulación de datos, optimización de consultas y consultas de bases de datos relacionales (PostGres)

- Experiencia práctica con AWS, incluidos los siguientes componentes de AWS: - AWS IAM - AWS Lambda - AWS EMR - AWS API Gateway - AWS ECR.

- Containerización (Docker)

- Orquestación de contenedores (ECS)

- CI/CD (idealmente Gitlab)

- Autorización/Autenticación (OAuth2)

Responsabilidades del desarrollador:

- Diseñar, desarrollar y desplegar (vía Git) aplicaciones y... servicios basados en Python.

- Integrar datos de diferentes fuentes usando SQL y Python, gestionar fases init y delta.

- Implementar soluciones basadas en AWS Lambda, EC2, ECS y Kinesis para el procesamiento y publicación de datos (conectores, etc.).

- Colaborar con equipos internos (PO, Scrum, etc.) para abordar las necesidades del negocio.

- Supervisar y mantener los sistemas existentes, asegurándose de que funcionan de forma fiable y eficiente.

Fomentamos un ambiente de trabajo multicultural e inclusivo, no discriminamos por edad, género o creencias; así como ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades a todo el personal.

Desarrollamos nuestras actividades bajo los principios del cuidado del medioambiente, la sostenibilidad y la responsabilidad social corporativa; colaborando en proyectos de reforestación y sostenibilidad.

Apoyamos los 10 principios del Pacto Mundial y los 17 Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible, en materia de derechos humanos, condiciones laborales, medio ambiente y anticorrupción.

Los procesos de reclutamiento se desarrollan bajo altos estándares de calidad definiendo la incorporación en base a la experiencia y habilidades del candidato.

Somos una empresa española líder en servicios tecnológicos y atracción del talento presente en el mercado desde 1995. Contamos con más de 600 empleados en proyectos tanto nacionales como internacionales en sector TI

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Python con experiencia en Ansible
jobs_results.description:
¡En Qindel Group estamos creciendo!

Por ello, estamos buscamos un/a desarrollador/a Python altamente motivado y experimentado para unirse a nuestro equipo con conocimientos en Ansible. En este rol, serás responsable de diseñar, implementar y mantener soluciones automatizadas utilizando tecnologías clave como Python, Ansible y Powershell.

Entre Tus Funciones Se Encontrarán Las Siguientes
• Desarrollar y mantener scripts y herramientas en Python para automatizar tareas de infraestructura.
• Diseñar, implementar y mantener flujos de trabajo automatizados utilizando Ansible.
• Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo y operaciones para mejorar la eficiencia y confiabilidad de la infraestructura.
• Crear scripts en Powershell para tareas específicas de administración en entornos Windows.
• Participar en la resolución de problemas y brindar soporte técnico cuando sea necesario.
• Generar documentación del código así como documentación de proyecto para entrega a cliente final.

Nuestra... filosofía se centra en equipos dinámicos, con autonomía, y en los que fluya la comunicación. Para conseguirlo, solemos trabajar con equipos medianos o pequeños, horarios continuados, estructuras horizontales, y bajo metodologías ágiles.

¿Qué te podemos ofrecer?
• Contrato indefinido.
• Horario continuo: de 08:00 a 16:15 de lun-jue; 08:00 a 15:00 viernes.
• Teletrabajo.
• Seguro médico privado, seguro dental, de vida y accidentes.
• Formación bonificada adaptada a tus necesidades.
• Salario competitivo, basado en tu formación y experiencia.

Requisitos mínimos

Requisitos

Estudios:

Ingeniería en computación, licenciaturas o grados afines.

Es Importante
• Al menos 3 años de experiencia comprobada en el desarrollo con Python.
• Experiencia sólida en la implementación de automatización de infraestructura con Ansible.
• Conocimientos prácticos de Powershell para administración de sistemas Windows.
• Experiencia en la integración de herramientas y flujos de trabajo en entornos de desarrollo y operaciones (DevOps).
• Familiaridad con tecnologías relacionadas con la nube (preferiblemente AWS, Azure o Google Cloud Platform).
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y colaborativa en un entorno ágil.
• Capacidad para generar documentación de alta calidad tanto a nivel código, como a nivel documentación de entrega de proyecto

• Practical analytical skills
• Nice to have: Kubernetes, graphql, AWS / Google Cloud as well as Agile / SCRUM / Kanban

• B2B contract type
• Full-time job
• Remote and flexible working hours

jobs_results.title: React + Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Join TALLERS SERRA, S.L., a leading manufacturer of industrial machinery for the corrugated cardboard sector, located in Martorell. We're seeking a React + Python Developer with experience in Django and React to contribute to the development of the graphical interface of an artificial vision product sold to clients.

As a React + Python Developer, you'll be responsible for maintaining and enhancing code functionality, crafting a SCADA system for cardboard plants. Join us in a dynamic environment where your professional growth is nurtured through diverse projects.

Enjoy a high level of autonomy, and we expect you to be both resourceful in your tasks and communicative in sharing your results.

Key Responsabilities

- Develop the graphical interface of a SCADA product using Python and React.

- Structure code and document its functionality using markdown or a wiki.

- Program Django APIs to connect the web with services and systems.

- Develop and implement an optimization system using... decision trees (chess-like).

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or equivalent.

- Advanced knowledge in Django and React.

- Proficiency in MySQL and MariaDB.

- Experience in user interface development and proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.

- Familiarity with design patterns and software development best practices.

- Organizational skills, autonomy in decision-making, and creativity in problem-solving.

- Demonstrable experience leading the conception, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of a project autonomously.

- Residency near Martorell.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in bug resolution, code structuring, and documentation.

- Experience in creating a licensing server.

- Experience in the industrial machinery sector.

- Knowledge of Artificial Vision.

- Knowledge of automatic engineering, industrial robotics.

- PLC programming knowledge (Rockwell and/or Siemens).

- Knowledge of PyQt5.

- Programming of Siemens touch screens (HMI).

- Programming of KUKA robots.

- Design and programming of industrial communications bus.

- Adaptability and flexibility.

- Ability to work in a team.

- Immediate availability.

Work Hours

Full-time employment with 40 hours per week, distributed as follows:

- Monday to Thursday: 07:30 to 13:30 and 14:15 to 17:00.

- Friday: 07:30 to 13:45.

Additional Benefits

- Flexible hours.

- Hybrid work model.

- Parking space.

Salary

We offer a competitive salary commensurate with the candidate's experience and expertise, along with professional development opportunities.

At TALLERS SERRA, S.L., we value innovation, commitment, and a passion for excellence in work

jobs_results.description:

Requisitos

Experiencia en programación en Python Aplicaciones Web y gestión de Base de Datos bajo entorno MySQL y desarrollo de interfaces automáticas para procesos de negocio (APIs).

Experiencia en Servicios de Google Cloud y conocimiento y experiencia de servicios de Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Experiencia en el trato con interlocutores clave (equipos de IT gestión de procesos equipos de soporte comerciales etc) para el desarrollo de la actividad.

Funciones

Mantener desarrollar e implementar herramientas en Python y alojadas en servicios de Google Cloud.

Obtener requerimientos de negocio.

Desarrollar APIs (Interfaces de negocio entre proveedores) para el desarrollo de servicios... automáticos.

Asegurar la actualización periódica mantenimiento y optimización de los repositorios de información y Base de datos que alimentan la operativa y proceso del Motor de Precios mediante procesos de Ingesta y ETLs.

Impartir sesiones de formación en (español e inglés) a los departamentos de preventa.

Elaboración de documentación.

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Python (Remote)
jobs_results.description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected... future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

About You

We are looking for someone who will is a whizz with Python, has experience with microservices and is happy to get stuck into a gritty and fast paced environment to work within our awesome Python team, championing and leading the build of secure, robust and high-performance systems.

The Opportunity

Our Python team works on building highly available low latency microservices from scratch using the newest bleeding-edge technologies.

You will work on projects that have a huge impact on our growing company, solving complex problems as we scale. You’ll be part of a group of people working together to build solutions to mission-critical problems and a company that values the very best ideas. People rely on our products to communicate daily, which means they rely on us to build things with a high degree of resiliency and reliability.
• Design developer-friendly APIs.
• Build, test, and deploy applications to deliver critical global communications services.
• Identify and resolve issues related to latency, scalability, and performance.
• Create tools to automate aspects of production systems.

Who We're Looking For
• 3+ years of professional software development experience with an object-oriented programming language.
• Experience with web application development using Python.
• Experience working with asynchronous programming.
• Comfort working with SQL and relational databases at scale.
• Experience in a highly-available, uptime-critical production environment.
• Deep knowledge of microservice architecture patterns and anti-patterns.
• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Consul, Jenkins, Prometheus, or RabbitMQ.

Bonus Points For
• You take a thoughtful approach to decision making, knowing when to move fast and when to long-term optimize.
• You want to work in a fast-paced, product-driven environment.
• You keep up to date with the latest technologies and patterns, and enjoy sharing what you’ve learned.

Bring Your Authentic Self to Telnyx

Telnyx is committed to building a team full of diverse perspectives, various backgrounds and different minds. We believe diversity drives innovation. We are committed to building a culture where difference is valued and creating avenues of equity for underserved groups. While we are still a work in progress, we are actively seeking folks who are passionate about building a place of belonging for everyone.

We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. We believe in transparency, proactivity, and mutual respect. We provide the high-grade tools that help you do your best work, and keep up the collaborative habits that help everyone stay in the loop. No matter where you're based or which team you’re on, you’re plugged in, supported, and helping to shape the future of communications.

You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Telnyx, we welcome diverse perspectives, rigorous thinkers and assumption challengers. Are you ready to join us

As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected... future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

About You

We are looking for someone who will is a whizz with Python, has experience with microservices and is happy to get stuck into a gritty and fast paced environment to work within our awesome Python team, championing and leading the build of secure, robust and high-performance systems.

The Opportunity

Our Python team works on building highly available low latency microservices from scratch using the newest bleeding-edge technologies.

You will work on projects that have a huge impact on our growing company, solving complex problems as we scale. You’ll be part of a group of people working together to build solutions to mission-critical problems and a company that values the very best ideas. People rely on our products to communicate daily, which means they rely on us to build things with a high degree of resiliency and reliability.
• Design developer-friendly APIs.
• Build, test, and deploy applications to deliver critical global communications services.
• Identify and resolve issues related to latency, scalability, and performance.
• Create tools to automate aspects of production systems.

Who We're Looking For
• 3+ years of professional software development experience with an object-oriented programming language.
• Experience with web application development using Python.
• Experience working with asynchronous programming.
• Comfort working with SQL and relational databases at scale.
• Experience in a highly-available, uptime-critical production environment.
• Deep knowledge of microservice architecture patterns and anti-patterns.
• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Consul, Jenkins, Prometheus, or RabbitMQ.

Bonus Points For
• You take a thoughtful approach to decision making, knowing when to move fast and when to long-term optimize.
• You want to work in a fast-paced, product-driven environment.
• You keep up to date with the latest technologies and patterns, and enjoy sharing what you’ve learned.

Bring Your Authentic Self to Telnyx

Telnyx is committed to building a team full of diverse perspectives, various backgrounds and different minds. We believe diversity drives innovation. We are committed to building a culture where difference is valued and creating avenues of equity for underserved groups. While we are still a work in progress, we are actively seeking folks who are passionate about building a place of belonging for everyone.

We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. We believe in transparency, proactivity, and mutual respect. We provide the high-grade tools that help you do your best work, and keep up the collaborative habits that help everyone stay in the loop. No matter where you're based or which team you’re on, you’re plugged in, supported, and helping to shape the future of communications.

You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Telnyx, we welcome diverse perspectives, rigorous thinkers and assumption challengers. Are you ready to join us

jobs_results.title: Distributed Systems Software Engineer, Python / Go
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking a software engineer with a passion for building and validating resilient distributed systems. At Canonical you can build a career and drive the success of those leveraging Canonical's Ubuntu and Juju to build multi-cloud deployable cloud applications.

We see quality engineering as a first class engineering practice and are looking for people who can bring deep engineering insights and a data driven approach to test automation, reporting and data analytics.

The Distributed Systems testing team at Canonical is responsible for ensuring the high quality of Canonical's Cloud solutions based on Juju, Terraform, OpenStack, Kubernetes when deployed under highly diverse conditions, from bare metal in customer data centers to public clouds like AWS, GCE, Azure.

As a software engineer you will have the opportunity to develop CI pipelines which power Canonical's cloud integration testing and reporting. Upcoming initiatives you will have the opportunity to contribute to include... expanding deployment capabilities to new clouds and developing AI/ML pipelines for automatic analysis of test results. A successful candidate is interested in tackling these problems, as well as imagining and leading new initiatives within the team and across Canonical.

Location: this is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like
• Create automated testing approaches and infrastructure for validating reliability, performance, and resilience of cloud orchestration tools and applications
• Enable engineering teams across Canonical to develop software with confidence by making distributed system testing tooling available across the company
• Enhance continuous integration pipelines for deploying and testing Canonical's cloud native products such as Kubeflow
• Deploy, manage, and debug highly distributed systems
• Monitor and report on automated testing efforts
• Collaborate daily with a globally distributed team

What we are looking for in you
• Solid background in modern test processes and strategies
• Experience with Python or Go development
• Strong object oriented development skills
• Ability to develop and ship production grade modern web applications
• Working knowledge of continuous integration tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub CI
• Knowledge of networking technologies and fundamentals
• Solid understanding of Linux system architecture
• A capacity for complex abstract thinking
• Capability for 2-4 weeks of international travel travel per year

Additional skills that you might also bring
• Collecting and analyzing large multidimensional datasets
• Operating data platforms: key-value stores, relational or document databases, event buses
• Work with cloud technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS
• Developing AI/ML pipelines

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
• Annual compensation review
• Recognition rewards
• Annual holiday leave
• Maternity and paternity leave
• Employee Assistance Programme
• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical believes a diverse workforce enhances our ability to deliver world class software and services which meet the world's computing needs. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status

jobs_results.description:
Si buscas un día a día de rutina y sin retos, este NO es tu sitio. En ábaco estamos buscando un desarrollador proactivo y que todos los días pensemos que tenemos a un mega crack en el equipo que nos demuestre que ningún reto tecnológico se le queda grande.

Ábaco es una Fintech dedicada al desarrollo de infraestructura tecnológica para generar inclusión financiera en América Latina. No existe ningún modelo igual al nuestro en toda la región, por lo que nos ayudarás a crear un camino que no existe, generando impacto en millones de personas cada día. Gracias a nuestra solución muchas personas pueden acceder a un crédito que les permite crecer y tener una vida mejor.

Trabajamos con las top startups a nivel mundial dentro de las cuales hemos desarrollado una solución embedded finanance única en la región.

Responsibilities
• Desarrollo de nuevas piezas para nuestra plataforma que permitan mejorar los procesos actuales
• Liderar el diseño de procesos y nuevas iniciativas en la... compañía

Qualifications
• Ingeniería Informática o similar
• Experiencia de al menos un año en app scraping y reverse engineering
• Experiencia de al menos tres años en Python y Django
• Adaptado a la metodología de trabajo basado en sprints y objetivos
• Visa para trabajar en España
• Español como lengua materna
